'''BobaofFett Daddy come home, we miss you!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[BobaofFett]]
* '''Published:''' 10 April 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' There Is Good In Him
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 TIGIH BobaofFett LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is the Second deck of four. The first four I've made in nearly 3 years.

== Notes ==

* Posted 'ENDOR:LANDING SITE' dested Endor: Rebel Landing Site (Forest) (Endor: Landing Platform is already a starting card); 'Staging Area' Staging Areas; 'Capitol Support' Capital Support.
* Revolution (unique) posted x2; dested as posted.

== Strategy ==

I tried to localize my forces on and around ENDOR. Use REVOLUTION to boost up your force drains. ENTRENCHMENT and IT COULD BE WORSE are there for slowing down force loss. try to deploy CRIX at HOME ONE:WAR ROOM to get his bonuses and to boost up home one. Be careful with the spreading out the ships too lin. There ment to hold ENDOR for CAPITOL SUPPORT. I've always had trouble making a I CAN SAVE HIM deck, so let me know if you think this can hold up or not.
